That you felt seen somewhere. That something beautiful found you — not because you went looking, but because you were paying attention. That you were, for one moment, exactly where you needed to be.

For anyone having a hard week. For anyone who needed to hear this today.

What makes you happy? Not the big things — not the vacations or the milestones. The small, specific, ordinary things.

Mine: the particular silence of early morning. A book I can't put down. The smell of something baking when I didn't start it. Matcha made slowly. Letters that arrive by hand.

When I asked this question on Instagram, the most common answer surprised me: real mail. Something hand-addressed. A letter that was meant for you.

That's what I'm building. Tell me one of yours in the comments. I read every one.
